baseline_models.focus_anchor: The three ظ ن ن occurrences at words 2, 15, and 16 surround the passive beautification and culminate in ظن السوء at word 17.
baseline_models.mechanism: A weakly grounded forecast about an untrusted outcome is made attractive inside the heart, then returns as apparent certainty and a total evil judgment. The cognate repetition makes the error recursive: supposition is not merely held but reinforced by its own internally improved appearance.

activation_trace.role: Weak-sign supposition supplies the unstable starting estimate that the expedition will not return.
An outcome whose end cannot be trusted supplies the unresolved risk that the speakers convert into permanence.
Certainty formed after an indication marks the hardened endpoint of the repeated supposition.
Making something appear good supplies the feedback operation that improves the forecast's felt plausibility.
Intrinsic ugliness supplies the moral quality of the final judgment despite its beautified presentation.

changed_reading.before: They made a pessimistic prediction and were condemned for it.
changed_reading.after: They ran an epistemic feedback loop in which fragile risk became attractive, attractiveness became evidence, and repeated supposition hardened into an evil certainty.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ق ل ب appears both in يَنقَلِبَ at word 5 and قُلُوبِكُمْ at word 14.
baseline_models.mechanism: The same root binds the denied outward return to the inward organ of judgment. The speakers deny that bodies can turn homeward while their own inner core has already turned the signs away from their proper face; the external no-return is generated by an internal reversal.

activation_trace.role: Return and destination supply the outward motion whose possibility the speakers deny.
The heart as understanding supplies the inner site where the denied outward turn is modeled.
Turning a thing away from its face supplies the distortion that converts ambiguous signs into a one-way outcome.
Displayed improvement supplies the finishing operation by which the inward reversal feels coherent.

changed_reading.before: Return and hearts are two unrelated uses of the same root.
changed_reading.after: The verse makes the denied outer turn a product of an inner turning: the heart reverses the evidentiary face of the journey and then declares homecoming impossible.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The forecast joins return to families, permanence, and the closing description قَوْمًا بُورًا.
baseline_models.mechanism: The speakers imagine the believers' households permanently emptied by non-return. The close then redirects that spatial image: vacancy and barrenness do not finally characterize the absent families but the forecasters' own collective state.

activation_trace.role: Kin and household belonging supply the social space imagined as deprived of its returning members.
Unending duration stretches the imagined household loss into a permanent condition.
An emptied, desolate dwelling materializes what 'never returning to their families' would do to domestic space.
Barren, vacant land returns the projected emptiness onto the people who made the forecast.
Coming to be in time makes the redirected barrenness a realized identity, not merely an insult.

changed_reading.before: They expected permanent deaths abroad and are then called ruined.
changed_reading.after: They project permanent vacancy onto the believers' homes, but the sentence turns that vacancy back onto them as their own barren social condition.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The copular close وَكُنتُمْ قَوْمًا بُورًا names a collective and predicates bُور of it.
baseline_models.mechanism: Risk avoidance preserves the group physically but arrests its capacity to rise, act, and circulate value. A named people remains standing in place while stagnation proceeds toward corruption; survival purchased by nonparticipation becomes a mode of collective waste.

activation_trace.role: Realized presence in time supplies the transition from a choice to an established condition.
A human collective supplies the social body whose viability is being diagnosed.
Standing still, exhaustion, and stoppage supply the group's arrested mode of self-preservation.
Stagnation that continues into spoilage supplies the causal path from inaction to collective corruption.
Ruin and corruption supply the terminal condition toward which the stagnation tends.

changed_reading.before: قَوْمًا بُورًا is a generic denunciation of doomed people.
changed_reading.after: It diagnoses a collective that remains present by refusing costly movement, yet becomes socially nonproductive and spoils through its own stoppage.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The dispatched Messenger and the trust-defined believers form the compound subject of the denied return to their sphere of belonging.
baseline_models.mechanism: The forecast imagines public mission as a one-way severance from domestic belonging. Dispatch, trust, and family reintegration cannot coexist in the forecasters' model, so being sent outward is treated as exile rather than a movement capable of return.

activation_trace.role: Dispatch and outward release supply the mission's movement away from home.
The carrier and carried message supply the public purpose that the forecast collapses into the traveler's fate.
Trusting assent supplies the followers' defining relation to the Messenger and his message.
Return to a destination supplies the missing second half of the imagined one-way dispatch.
The near circle of kin and belonging supplies the social destination from which mission is falsely severed.

changed_reading.before: The sentence simply predicts that two groups of travelers will die.
changed_reading.after: It exposes an imagination in which being sent for a trusted public purpose can only end in permanent exile from ordinary belonging.

context_deltas.mechanism: The denied homeward turn is bracketed by an accomplished opening at the start of the surah and a later counterfactual in which the adversaries are the ones who turn their backs. Direction is reassigned: the Messenger's outward movement opens victory, while failed retreat belongs to the opposing force.

activation_trace.role: Homeward return supplies the motion that the focus forecast declares permanently unavailable.
An opening into victory supplies the actual outcome of the journey misread as terminal loss.
Turning one's back in retreat transfers irreversible outbound motion from the believers to their opponents.

structural_cues: 48:1 states an accomplished opening before the focus, while 48:22 assigns bodily turning-away to the opposing side.
The focus's لن ... أبدا is therefore held inside a sequence that redistributes who turns, who returns, and what the departure produces.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed motion and outcome images; I infer a directional chiasm in which the forecasters assign terminal motion to the wrong party. The live alternative is that the opening and enemy retreat are separate assurances without a deliberate lexical answer to ينقلب.

changed_reading.before: The speakers merely underestimate the travelers' chance of survival.
changed_reading.after: They map direction backward: the Messenger's departure is an opening that permits return, while the terminal turning-away they imagine for him is assigned to the adversary.

context_deltas.mechanism: Across the packet, hearts are not neutral containers. Tranquility comes to believing hearts, zeal is placed in rejecting hearts, and the focus's no-return model is beautified in the stayers' hearts. The focus therefore depicts a rival heart-formation: an attractive internal stabilization that imitates settled confidence while carrying a false outcome.

activation_trace.role: The heart as understanding supplies the shared interior site in which distinct dispositions take hold.
Making the forecast look good supplies the counterfeit mode by which it settles inwardly.
Cessation of agitation supplies the genuine settling placed in believing hearts.
Known heart-content supplies the contrasting interior that is answered with tranquility rather than beautified conjecture.
Proud heat and anger supply another disposition explicitly installed in hearts, clarifying the heart as a contested causal site.
Settled stillness supplies the counterforce placed upon the Messenger and believers.

structural_cues: The packet repeats heart constructions at 48:4, 48:11, 48:12, 48:18, and 48:26.
Different predicates govern those interiors: tranquility descends, zeal is placed, and the fatal forecast is beautified.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies different contents and operations around repeated hearts; I infer rival modes of inward stabilization, with beautification mimicking the felt quiet of confidence. The alternative is a looser thematic contrast in which زُيِّنَ has no formal relation to sakinah.

changed_reading.before: The passive beautification reports generic self-deception.
changed_reading.after: It describes a counterfeit heart-settlement: a pleasing fatalism occupies the same interior site where the packet elsewhere locates tranquility or heated zeal.

context_deltas.mechanism: In 48:11 the stayers put wealth and family on their tongues as the cause of absence, while the verse says their tongues do not match their hearts. The focus then repeats family and heart but supplies the concealed calculation: they expected the Messenger and believers not to return. Family changes from actual impediment to rhetorical cover for a privately advantageous forecast.

activation_trace.role: Family belonging supplies the repeated term whose function shifts from excuse to object of the concealed prediction.
Accusatory suspicion supplies the hostile inner content hidden behind the respectable family claim.
Occupation rather than availability supplies the overt causal excuse for staying behind.
Kin and household supply the socially credible cover named by the stayers.
The speech organ supplies the external channel explicitly separated from inward content.
The heart as understanding supplies the concealed layer that the focus immediately reconstructs.

structural_cues: 48:11 immediately precedes the focus and contrasts tongue with heart.
The sequence repeats أهل from the excuse and قلب from the concealment, then places the no-return scenario inside that heart.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacency, repeated family and heart language, and an explicit mouth-heart mismatch; I infer that 48:12 discloses the principal hidden rationale. The live alternative is that 48:11's hidden content is broader insincerity and 48:12 gives only one component of it.

changed_reading.before: The no-return belief is an independent mistaken prediction.
changed_reading.after: It is the concealed calculation behind a family-centered alibi: domestic duty is spoken, while inwardly the speakers expect the committed party to disappear.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah speaks of not believing in God and His Messenger. That adjacency activates the accusatory and hostile branches of repeated supposition: the no-return model is not only poor risk analysis but an implicit charge that the Messenger's dispatch and message cannot be trusted.

activation_trace.role: Suspicion as accusation supplies the forecast's tacit indictment of the Messenger's undertaking.
Hostile suspicion supplies the relational antagonism carried by what first looks like detached pessimism.
Trusting assent supplies the relation whose absence makes the no-return story plausible to the stayers.
The message-bearing envoy supplies the object against which the failed trust is directed.

structural_cues: 48:13 follows the focus with the construction ومن لم يؤمن بالله ورسوله.
The focus itself names both الرسول and المؤمنون inside the rejected-return scenario.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies immediate adjacency and repeated Messenger-belief terms; I infer that the general warning classifies the preceding posture as a trust failure. The alternative is that 48:13 broadens beyond the stayers without specifically redescribing their forecast.

changed_reading.before: Their error is emotionally pessimistic but relationally neutral.
changed_reading.after: Their forecast functions as a tacit accusation against the reliability of the sent message and therefore as failed trust, not merely fear.

context_deltas.mechanism: When the journey appears lethal, the stayers are certain there will be no return; when gains become available, the same group asks to follow. The changing payout reveals the earlier certainty as motivated cognition: danger was amplified and beautified when it justified nonparticipation, then mobility reappeared when acquisition was visible.

activation_trace.role: An untrusted outcome supplies the uncertainty selectively resolved toward fatal loss when participation is costly.
Making the preferred scenario look good supplies the incentive-sensitive distortion.
Acquiring and winning something supplies the new payoff that reverses the stayers' willingness to move.
Failure of comprehension supplies the packet's diagnosis of their inability to read beyond immediate advantage.

structural_cues: 48:15 names the same المخلفون and has them request inclusion when spoils are the destination.
Their movement preference changes with the visible payoff, while the focus's absolute forecast had presented itself as objective certainty.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the same group's opposite participation choices under different incentives; I infer that expected payoff helps cause the earlier risk judgment. The alternative is sincere fear followed by regret, though the stated lack of understanding keeps motivated cognition live.

changed_reading.after: They manufacture certainty in the direction that protects present advantage, then revise their appetite for movement when gain replaces risk.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus moves from uncertain signs to لن and أبدا, converting a bounded human estimate into universal impossibility. At 48:21, what lies outside human capacity is nevertheless fully encompassed. This exposes the hidden inference: 'we cannot see or secure the route' became 'the return can never occur.'

activation_trace.role: Uncertain estimation supplies the limited evidence from which the absolute conclusion is drawn.
Unending duration supplies the unjustified scale of the conclusion.
Capacity sufficient for action supplies the bounded human ability that the context explicitly says was lacking.
Complete encompassing in knowledge and possession supplies the larger horizon omitted from the focus forecast.

structural_cues: The focus couples لن with أبدا, while 48:21 contrasts لم تقدروا with قد أحاط الله بها.
Both passages move from a human relation to a future outcome toward a claim about that outcome's reach.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies limited capacity and larger encompassing; I supply the arrow that the stayers projected their own limit onto reality. The alternative is that 48:21 concerns later gains and offers only an analogical epistemic correction.

changed_reading.before: They make a factually wrong absolute prediction.
changed_reading.after: Their deeper error is scale conversion: private incapacity and uncertain access are inflated into an eternal limit on what can happen.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus uses أهل for the families to whom return is denied; 48:26 uses the same root for being fit and entitled to the word of protection. Belonging therefore doubles: the believers return to a kin-group, but they are also themselves the qualified people of a binding word. The stayers misread both where the believers belong and what makes a people viable.

activation_trace.role: Family and near belonging supply the physical-social destination allegedly lost forever.
Barrenness supplies the failed collective belonging assigned instead to the forecasters.
Fitness and entitlement supply a second kind of belonging possessed by the Messenger's committed group.
Binding and fastening by a norm supplies the relation that makes them its qualified people.
Fixed entitlement supplies the stated warrant for that ethical belonging.

structural_cues: The exact root ء ه ل occurs in the focus's أهليهم and in 48:26's وأهلها.
48:26 coordinates أحق بها with أهلها after the word is made binding upon the Messenger and believers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two live senses of one root; I infer a contrast between kin belonging and normative qualification. The alternative is ordinary local polysemy with no intended cross-activation.

changed_reading.before: أهليهم only names bereaved families awaiting travelers.
changed_reading.after: The denied homecoming sits inside a wider test of belonging: those predicted to lose their أهل are shown to possess ahliyya, while the forecasters become the barren collective.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus offers a self-beautified future image based on supposition; 48:27 offers a dream confirmed in truth, secure entry, and knowledge beyond the audience. The contrast is not optimism versus pessimism but rival warrant structures: one image feeds on its own attractiveness, while the other is tied to truth and fulfilled action.

activation_trace.role: Weakly warranted imagining supplies the false future representation.
A feared bad outcome supplies the affective content that the false representation projects.
Making a promise true in action supplies external confirmation rather than self-confirmation.
A dream-vision supplies the competing future image whose warrant the context explicitly establishes.
Truth fixed in correspondence with reality supplies the vision's grounding.
Secure calm supplies the embodied outcome that directly contradicts permanent non-return.

structural_cues: 48:27 promises entry with emphatic future form and the state آمنين, then says that God knew what the audience did not know.
The focus also concerns an unseen future, but marks its representation as beautified supposition and evil.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two future representations and sharply different warrant terms; I infer an epistemic foil. The alternative is that the confirmed dream addresses timing of sanctuary entry without directly answering the stayers' death forecast.

changed_reading.before: The focus condemns pessimism and the context later supplies an optimistic promise.
changed_reading.after: The packet distinguishes self-sealing conjecture from truth-backed vision: valence is secondary to whether the future image has warrant outside its own appeal.

context_deltas.mechanism: At 48:28 the Messenger is again defined through sending, guidance, truth, and the message's prevalence. This reopens the focus's compound subject: the stayers reduce a dispatched mission to whether its carrier completes a round trip, while the packet presents transmission as an outward trajectory whose efficacy exceeds that travel calculation.

activation_trace.role: Being sent outward supplies the movement that the stayers mistake for one-way loss.
Return and destination supply the narrow round-trip measure imposed on the mission.
The envoy and carried message supply a mission identity that cannot be reduced to the carrier's travel risk.
A lived order of obedience supplies the social field into which the message is meant to propagate.
Rising to prevalence supplies the onward result that outlasts the stayers' one-trip model.

structural_cues: 48:28 repeats رسول through the formula هو الذي أرسل رسوله and gives the sending a stated purpose.
The focus binds الرسول to physical return, whereas 48:28 binds him to the outward efficacy of guidance and truth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dispatch, message, and prevalence; I infer that the stayers collapse mission efficacy into carrier survival. The alternative is that 48:28 simply restates the Messenger's commission after his safe return.

changed_reading.before: The stayers miscalculate whether the Messenger will complete a dangerous journey.
changed_reading.after: They mistake the mission for a fragile round trip and cannot imagine a sending whose truth-bearing trajectory reorganizes the field through which the carrier travels.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing crop image supplies a complete collective growth sequence: sowing, emerging shoots, mutual strengthening, thickening, and upright load-bearing stalks. Against that sequence, قَوْمًا بُورًا becomes the anti-crop: a group that stays in place to preserve itself but produces neither new growth nor supporting structure and therefore passes from stagnation to barrenness.

activation_trace.role: Stoppage and exhaustion supply the arrested collective posture that the later crop reverses.
Barren empty land supplies the ecological negative against which the closing growth process reads.
Cultivation and growth supply the generative collective process absent from the barren people.
Shoots emerging around an origin supply multiplication without abandonment of the source.
Plants strengthening one another supply mutual support as the engine of collective durability.
Thickening after thinness supplies maturation from vulnerability into resilient substance.
Rising and settling upright supplies stable attainment rather than immobilized stagnation.
The load-bearing stalk supplies the mature structure through which the collective can stand.

structural_cues: The focus closes with a people predicated as بُور, while 48:29 closes the surah with an extended crop-development sequence.
The crop does not merely survive; its parts emerge, support one another, thicken, and stand.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lexical barrenness and an explicit social crop model; I infer a surah-scale counter-image between two kinds of collective persistence. The alternative is that بُور remains generic ruin and the crop independently praises believers.

changed_reading.before: The stayers are doomed, while the believers are later praised with an unrelated crop simile.
changed_reading.after: The stayers are an anti-crop: self-preserving immobility makes them barren, while committed movement generates shoots, support, thickness, and stable collective standing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's false outcome is cosmetically improved inside hearts; 48:29 presents a visible mark on faces as the lasting effect of embodied prostration. The contrast creates two evidentiary surfaces: an appearance with no demonstrated cause except beautification, and an appearance that carries the residue of repeated action.

activation_trace.role: Making something look good supplies the unsupported cosmetic plausibility of the no-return story.
The hidden interior supplies the location where the attractive appearance avoids public testing.
A sign from which an observer reads condition supplies the visible and interpretable counter-appearance.
The face as forward visible surface supplies the public location of the mark.
A lasting sign that indicates a prior event supplies the causal residue linking appearance to practice.
The bodily members and effect of prostration supply the action from which the visible sign derives.

structural_cues: 48:12 locates beautification in hearts; 48:29 locates a readable mark on faces and gives it a causal من أثر construction.
Both passages concern how an appearance is produced and then treated as evidence of an inward condition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hidden beautification and a visible action-trace; I infer a contrast of evidentiary provenance. The alternative is that the two appearance complexes are independent and should not be made into a deliberate foil.

changed_reading.before: Beautification simply means that a bad idea felt attractive.
changed_reading.after: Its defect is also evidentiary: it is an inward cosmetic with no tested cause, unlike a visible mark presented as the durable effect of embodied practice.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a material branch of ق ل ب rather than the ordinary heart or return senses. It remains anchored in the root's double occurrence and the passive beautification inside hearts, but downstream prose should present it as a material analogy for cognitive fixation, not as the lexical meaning of قلوب here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ق ل ب joins the denied return and the heart, while زُيِّنَ describes an operation performed within that heart.

activation_trace.role: A mold into which material is poured supplies an image of the heart fixing a fluid possibility into one repeatable scenario.
Applied adornment supplies the finishing layer that makes the molded scenario desirable to retain.
Apparent certainty after a sign supplies the rigid cognitive product that comes out of the mold.

changed_reading.before: A thought is made appealing in the heart.
changed_reading.after: A still-fluid risk estimate is poured into an inner قالب, finished with adornment, and reproduced as a fixed certainty.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a form-distant activation because the surface أبدا ordinarily marks duration while the cited branch concerns a wild or stray word. It remains anchored at the verse's emphatic absolute and the adjacent untrusted-outcome branch of ظ ن ن; render it only as metalinguistic wordplay that diagnoses runaway certainty, never as a replacement translation of أبدا.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The emphatic أَبَدًا at word 10 turns a conjecture about an uncertain outcome into unrestricted permanence.

activation_trace.role: A wild, stray word supplies a metalinguistic image for the absolute escaping the limits of its evidence.
An outcome that cannot be trusted supplies the narrow uncertainty from which the verbal absolute runs loose.

changed_reading.before: أبدا merely intensifies how long they expect non-return to last.
changed_reading.after: The very word of permanence can be heard, experimentally, as the forecast's runaway word: an absolute that has gone wild beyond its evidentiary enclosure.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the dominant local force of بُور is ruin or barrenness, not testing. It remains valid as a secondary branch activation attached to the final predicate and the realized-state construction; downstream prose should say the outcome exposes or assays their condition while retaining ruin as the primary sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The close وَكُنتُمْ قَوْمًا بُورًا presents بُور as the realized predicate of what the group had become.

activation_trace.role: Testing a thing to discover its condition supplies an assay-image for how the failed forecast reveals the group.
A state coming to be in time supplies the condition made visible by that assay.
Ruin and corruption preserve the dominant result whose exposure the exploratory assay supplements.

changed_reading.before: The ending only announces a fixed verdict of ruin.
changed_reading.after: The journey and its misreading also function as an assay: they disclose in action the ruined collective condition that the final predicate names.

strongest_changes: The adjacency of 48:11 turns family from a genuine cause of absence into the tongue-level alibi for a concealed no-return calculation.
Repeated heart constructions distinguish beautified fatalism from tranquility and heated zeal, making the focus a model of rival inward formations.

48:21, 48:22, and 48:27 expose three errors in the forecast: human incapacity is absolutized, retreat is assigned to the wrong party, and self-confirming supposition is confused with truth-backed vision.
48:26 and 48:29 reopen أهل and بُور as a contrast between qualified belonging and collective barrenness, culminating in the believers' mutually supported crop growth.
The visible action-trace on faces in 48:29 creates a live evidentiary foil to the unsupported cosmetic plausibility installed in hearts at 48:12.
summary.what_was_special: The packet repeatedly reuses the focus's own heart, belief, Messenger, family, and collective-state roots, then closes with both a causal visible mark and a full growth mechanism. That structure supports several coexisting readings rather than one harmonized moral: motivated cognition, directional reversal, rival heart formation, contested belonging, epistemic scale error, and ecological nonproductivity.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus leaves the agent and exact process of زُيِّنَ unstated, so the rival-installation model remains abductive rather than syntactically explicit.
The cross-activation between family أهل and qualified أهل may be designed polysemy or only a productive reader-side linkage.
The crop and visible-mark contrasts are strong packet-level mechanisms, but their degree of direct reference back to قَوْمًا بُورًا and زُيِّنَ cannot be forced.
The mold, wild-word, and assay branches should remain visibly exploratory and must not displace the ordinary lexical readings.
